info.title: Inventory & Order Management API
info.description: Single-business, multi-warehouse inventory API. Monetary amounts use integer cents in one business currency. Orders reserve stock on creation. Authentication uses expiring Sanctum bearer tokens. No public signup, payments, tax calculation, returns or multi-tenancy are included.

post.summary: Log in and issue a token valid for 24 hours
